program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and r > 0 and r < h - 1:
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(a) == len(b):
                return [[2 if a[i][j] != 0 and b[i][j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(a))]
    for c in range(w):
        col = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(col)) == 1 and c > 0 and c < w - 1:
            a = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            b = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            if len(a[0]) == len(b[0]):
                return [[2 if a[i][j] != 0 and b[i][j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(len(a[0]))] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("No matching divider found")
